args.subject: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail): label confusion
args.body:
June,

A few notes on the Pellow Home Living label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- Some records still use the old name. A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", and one version of the Inbound arrivals export still has the old Covey & Lark Retail header.
- "Covey" in older notes refers to the same account as Pellow Home Living.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the dropdowns when filing tickets.

Could you check whether the deal desk records need the new name? I'll get the saved report label changed.

Sofia
